description: The contract address of a token named by ticker or name (CLAUS, STANDARD, 'pepe'), on Robinhood Chain by default or Solana, Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum or HyperEVM: every token with that name that trades in a pool, ranked by the liquidity behind it, with its 24-hour volume, pools, price, oldest pool and explorer link; on Robinhood Chain each candidate's name, symbol and supply are read from the contract. `pick` names the one the market clearly trades (10x the liquidity of any other with that ticker); when several share the ticker and none dominates, there is no pick: show the candidates and ask. Use this first whenever a question names a token without an address, then pass the address to token_quote, token_report, token_holders, bundle_check, dev_check or token_risk. Not for stocks: stock tokens are stocks_list and stock_quote. Candidates from GeckoTerminal's public DEX index, read-only.

query.description: The token's ticker or name, e.g. 'CLAUS' or 'standard'

name: token_search
title: Find a token by name or ticker
